metaTitle: Custom Rainbow Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rainbow badge reels for your team. Perfect for Pride events, retail, and inclusive branding. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Rainbow badge reels offer a vibrant way to show support for inclusivity and pride while keeping ID badges accessible. Whether you're outfitting staff for a Pride parade, equipping retail teams with a colorful uniform accessory, or creating a fun giveaway for a diversity event, these reels stand out. Available with full-color imprinting on the reel body, they can feature your logo alongside the rainbow pattern. The durable retractable cord and sturdy clip ensure they hold up to daily use.
heroAltText: Custom rainbow badge reels with retractable cord and clip, featuring a colorful rainbow pattern and company logo
